reasoned_assessment: Codex inspected actual release Governor/ending/Pin/legacy-resume frames. Original tactics, portrait/cue identity and announced threats remain readable in this software-rendered sample. Self-contained execution removes a concrete setup step; no stronger gameplay, human installation success or commercial appeal is inferred.
resolved_execution_findings: First isolated export lacked a solution, reported .NET errors despite exit 0; maintained solution and strict error gate correct this.
Godot importer omits raw PNG/WAV even with broad include filters. Sidecar original media and executable-relative loading make the actual player work.
Source import generated a previously absent Presentation UID. Track it and rebuild source identity; unused media import sidecars are ignored.
The first damaged-ZIP fixture mutated its original ZipInfo before reading; corrected only the scratch harness with copied metadata. That failed attempt is not a product failure/pass.
V-Sync is unsupported on the virtual display; actual OpenGL/AudioServer checks still complete.
Environment restart preserved final hashes and complete logs/proofs; no abandoned pending command is counted as a pass.
